thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 09/11/2018: USAT, MTZ, DGLY, OSTK

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 09/11/2018: USAT, MTZ, DGLY, OSTK
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.4%
AAPL: +0.06%
IBM: +0.01%
CSCO: -0.3%
GOOG: flat
Technology shares were lower in pre-market trading on Tuesday.
Expected movers:
- USA Technologies ( USAT ) said it will not be able to file its 2018 10-K annual report by the Sept. 13 due date
- MasTec ( MTZ ) completed its $100 million common stock repurchase plan, and has authorized the repurchase of up to an additional $150 million of its common stock
- Digital Ally ( DGLY ) said US Patent Office granted the company two new patents
Other news:
- Overstock.com ( OSTK ) founder and CEO Patrick Byrne disclosed the sale of 10% of his holding of the company's shares.
